Jenna Parker has always dreamed of becoming a professional surfer, but she finds herself in a difficult position when she moves to Los Angeles with her ex- boyfriend and no job prospects. She has to rely on herself and her passion for the sport to survive, spending her days surfing the waves and nights at a local surf store helping repair boards.

One day, while walking along the shore, Jenna stumbled upon a mysterious beach party and met Kaila, a beautiful and wealthy young woman with her own surf store and a passion for surfing. They bond over their shared love of the sport and Jenna decides to train with Kaila's team to prepare for more competitions.

Kaila helps Jenna with her training, providing her with the necessary equipment and guidance to improve her skills. They also start to compete in local competitions and quickly become known as the best surfers in their area.

Jenna's career takes off, and she earnes a spot in a major surfing competition held in Rincon. The winner will receive a generous cash prize that could have helped her relaunch her surfing career. However, just before the contest, Jenna's van breaks down and she must withdraw from the contest.

Jenna is determined to make it back to her life as a surfer, but she must first find a way to support herself and her new team. She works as a customer service representative at a local restaurant and uses her skills to help her colleagues improve their service.

As Jenna's career continues to take off, she finds herself in a new and exciting relationship with a new surfer, who helps her to stay focused and motivated on her journey. Despite the challenges she faces, Jenna is determined to achieve her dream of becoming a professional surfer and make the most of her life.
